heading.holds: Heading text, hierarchy level, optional numbering.
heading.fragmentation: Must be bound with the first following block in one break-inside:avoid wrapper. Never render alone.
heading.emphasis: Type size, weight, rule, and spacing only. No box.
heading.screen_layer: Review wrapper may show selection and hierarchy controls outside the print subtree.

prose.fragmentation: Splits freely with widows/orphans. Paragraphs may split.
prose.emphasis: Inline weight, italic, small caps, and whitespace. No background or border.
prose.screen_layer: Optional hover boundary and edit handle outside print subtree.
prose.earns_its_place_when: Default. Use unless another object earns its place against it.
prose.reject_when: Never rejected. Prose is the fallback.

list.holds: Ordered or unordered items with optional lead-in.
list.fragmentation: List may split between items; individual item avoids splitting when practical.
list.emphasis: Markers, hanging indent, weight, and spacing. No box.
list.screen_layer: Editing controls wrap list; no student-visible object label.
list.earns_its_place_when: Three or more genuinely parallel items that lose nothing when the connective prose between them is removed.
list.reject_when: Fewer than three items, or items that need explaining to one another. Two bullets is a sentence.

table.holds: Columns, rows, header, caption, and semantic presentation hint.
table.fragmentation: May split across pages. thead repeats. Rows avoid splitting.
table.emphasis: Rules, alignment, weight, and sparse header tint only when photocopy-safe. No enclosing box.
table.screen_layer: Column resize/edit affordances outside print subtree.
table.earns_its_place_when: Two or more columns of comparable values AND two or more rows, with every cell fillable.
table.reject_when: One column of values, or any cell that would be empty, 'n/a', or a full sentence.

figure.holds: Image or SVG asset, caption, alt text, width hint.
figure.fragmentation: Figure and caption are atomic. May move to next page.
figure.emphasis: Scale, whitespace, caption typography, and optional hairline around the plate only—not a card.
figure.screen_layer: Asset status and replacement controls outside print subtree.
figure.earns_its_place_when: Spatial, sequential, or structural content the reader would otherwise have to construct mentally.
figure.reject_when: Decorative, or the caption would restate the surrounding prose.

aside.holds: Short set-apart note with optional student-facing label.
aside.fragmentation: Atomic. Margin placement uses float, clear:right, and negative margin. Move cleanly if it does not fit.
aside.emphasis: The only object allowed a border or background. Default is a single vertical rule with restrained label.
aside.screen_layer: Can receive intent badge in teacher review only; badge excluded from print.
aside.earns_its_place_when: One short point that must sit outside the reading line without breaking it.
aside.reject_when: Longer than the margin column holds, or the point belongs in the flow. If it will not fit in 40 words it is prose.

worked-example.holds: Problem/setup, ordered reasoning steps, final answer, optional checks.
worked-example.fragmentation: May split between steps. A step avoids internal split where practical. Final step and answer stay together.
worked-example.emphasis: Numbered steps, hanging labels, indentation, and rules. No enclosing box.
worked-example.screen_layer: Step editing and collapse controls may exist only in review shell.
worked-example.earns_its_place_when: A complete instance from setup to answer, with every step visible.
worked-example.reject_when: No final answer, or steps the learner is meant to supply themselves.

questions.holds: Open prompts, marks, response guidance, answer-space specification.
questions.fragmentation: Split between questions, never inside a question. Prompt stays with minimum answer space.
questions.emphasis: Hanging numbers, marks aligned to edge, ruled answer space. No cards.
questions.screen_layer: Teacher may inspect answer metadata in adjacent review panel.
questions.earns_its_place_when: The learner must produce something in their own words or working.
questions.reject_when: Fixed options exist — use choices. Or nothing is actually being asked.

choices.fragmentation: Atomic when it fits; otherwise keep stem with at least two options and split only between options.
choices.emphasis: Letters A/B/C/D, hanging indent, whitespace. Never radio controls.
choices.screen_layer: Interactive selection may appear in review mode but print renderer emits letters only.
choices.earns_its_place_when: Selection is the response AND every wrong option carries diagnostic meaning.
choices.reject_when: Distractors are filler, or the answer cannot be reduced to a selectable option.

answer-key.holds: Question references, expected answers, alternatives, working, rubric and misconceptions.
answer-key.fragmentation: Split between entries. Entry keeps question reference with first answer line.
answer-key.emphasis: Heading hierarchy, compact typography, rules. No card.
answer-key.screen_layer: Teacher-only visibility control outside document content.
